# Startup Labs Global

> Startup Labs Global designs and delivers accelerators, workshops and bootcamps for corporations, governments and institutions. Founded in 2014, it has run 50+ programmes with 20+ partner organisations, reaching 30+ countries and supporting 750+ startups.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.startup-labs.org/): what Startup Labs does, its six services, results and partner testimonials
- [About](https://www.startup-labs.org/about): history since 2014, approach and operating principle
- [Contact](https://www.startup-labs.org/contact): how to start an engagement; replies within a week

## Services

- Accelerator programme design: end-to-end accelerator architecture, mentor networks and programme management
- Workshop development: bespoke entrepreneurship workshop series and facilitator training
- Innovation bootcamp delivery: intensive ideation and prototyping programmes inside organisations
- Corporate innovation programmes: corporate venture building and startup partnership programmes
- Founder readiness advisory: pitch decks, investor readiness and fundraising
- Research and evaluation: impact measurement, ecosystem mapping and evidence-led programme design
